summary: Tested Email Notification System - All backend and frontend tests passed. Backend: 22/22 tests passed covering SMTP providers (4), categories (7), SMTP config CRUD, role notification settings CRUD, and access control. Frontend: All UI flows working - Meldingen button, SMTP Config tab with provider dropdown, Custom provider host/port fields, Rol Meldingen tab with roles list, mode selectors, and category toggles.
seed_data_creation: Test SMTP config created during testing with test@example.com username
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email notification system fully functional. SMTP test will fail with real test since no valid SMTP credentials are configured - this is expected behavior. Role notification settings persist correctly. All data-testid attributes working properly.

backend_passed: GET /api/notifications/smtp-providers returns 4 providers (microsoft365, google, outlook, custom)
Each SMTP provider has name, host, port, use_tls fields
GET /api/notifications/categories returns 7 categories (security, firewall, content, shows, users, wordpress, system)
Each category has id, name, description
PUT /api/notifications/smtp-config saves config with masked password
GET /api/notifications/smtp-config returns stored config with masked password (••••••••)
PUT /api/notifications/smtp-config with custom provider accepts host/port
POST /api/notifications/smtp-test with masked password fetches stored password
GET /api/notifications/role-settings returns empty dict or saved settings
All protected endpoints require network admin role
frontend_passed: Meldingen button visible in Network Dashboard toolbar (data-testid='notification-settings-btn')
SMTP Config tab visible by default (data-testid='notif-tab-smtp')
Provider dropdown shows Microsoft 365 as default (data-testid='smtp-provider-select')
Provider dropdown has all 4 providers (microsoft365, google, outlook, custom)
Selecting Custom provider shows Host/Port fields (data-testid='smtp-host', 'smtp-port')
SMTP form has username, password, from_email, from_name fields
Rol Meldingen tab shows 4 roles (Admin, Presenter, Editor, Viewer)
Clicking role expands it to show settings
Mode selector has 3 options (Real-time, Dagelijks, Beide)
All 7 category toggles present (security, firewall, content, shows, users, wordpress, system)
Mode selector is functional (can select different modes)
Instellingen Opslaan button saves role settings
Success toast appears after saving ('Rol meldingen opgeslagen')

notes: SMTP test connection will fail because no real SMTP server is configured - this is expected. The test verifies the endpoint returns proper response format. Frontend uses data-testid attributes consistently for testing. Console shows 405 errors for some favicon/resource requests but these don't affect functionality.
